Why do studios switch to Northwind?

Bank feed reconciliation
Transactions are matched to invoices and receipts automatically, and anything unmatched is queued for a two-second review instead of a two-hour hunt.
Invoice drafts
Recurring clients get a draft invoice on the first of the month; you approve it or edit it before it goes out. Late reminders are sent for you.
Accountant handoff
Export a period as a locked ledger with every attachment. In our 2025 customer survey, 78% of accountants said the handoff took under 15 minutes.

What does it cost?

Plans start at $24 per month for a single studio and $59 per month for up to three. Every plan includes unlimited invoices, bank feeds, and the accountant export. There is no setup fee.
